business_problem: Accenture needed to unify a decentralized global sales organization and reduce the administrative work that limited seller productivity, proposal speed, and consistent account planning at scale.
solution_summary: Accenture reinvented its internal sales stack around Salesforce, Agentforce, and generative AI to create a more unified and productive global selling model. Core sales and enablement processes were centralized into Manage MySales (MMS), where Agentforce Assistant now handles user questions and is evolving from guidance into task execution. Additional AI services such as Account Advisor generate insights and presentation drafts for strategic accounts, while Agentforce Sales Coach provides real-time guidance that helps sellers improve client interactions. The architecture blends workflow standardization with predictive analytics, real-time dashboards across countries, and orchestration through the Sales IT Investment Board so custom, out-of-the-box, and third-party agents are governed consistently. By pairing Salesforce innovation with Accenture proprietary assets like AI Refinery and Amethyst, the sales organization moved proposal preparation, account planning, and coaching into AI-assisted workflows that are reusable across a very large global user base.

data_flow: Sales activity, account data, and process workflows flow through Salesforce and MMS, where Agentforce services answer questions, generate proposals and insights, and coach sellers in real time. Governed AI outputs are then used by global sales teams for account planning, proposals, and opportunity execution.
business_outcome: Accenture reduced proposal effort, scaled higher-quality account planning to more teams, and made AI-driven guidance available across a global sales organization without relying on purely manual seller support.
